fields.name: unused_head
fields.meaning: Unused; zero in every observed save, never read (boot reads start at 0x0010)
fields.evidence: diffs of all saves; boot read trace starts at 0x0010

fields.name: file1_check
fields.meaning: File 1 check word: low byte = XOR of the 0x1A3 bytes from 0x0012, high byte = 8-bit sum of the same bytes
fields.evidence: code c000:CA85 computes, c000:CAC6 compares; recomputed over every save image holding a file (all match)

fields.name: file1_magic
fields.meaning: Signature "YAMATO"; a file counts as valid only when the check word and this text both match
fields.evidence: code c000:CB53 writes, c000:CB10 checks

fields.name: f1_unknown_18
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero in every observed save
fields.evidence: diffs

fields.name: f1_stage
fields.meaning: Current stage number (1-based; 2 shows as STAGE 02-1); also selects the stage title on the Load screen
fields.evidence: incremented by c000:41A0 (1->2 seen across two play states); Load screen reads it at 4000:84E0; stage numbers up to 27 in code

fields.name: f1_stage_part
fields.meaning: Part within the stage (the "-1" of STAGE 02-1); reset to 1 on every stage change
fields.evidence: code c000:4327 and c000:CA20 write 1 after stage change; 1 in all saves

fields.name: f1_var_1b
fields.meaning: Unknown live-state byte; always 0 when saved, used and zeroed by battle and stage code
fields.evidence: zeroed by new-game init 6000:1DC0 and stage reset c000:CA25; live writers 6000:1ECB/1EFE/1FB0/44DE, c000:2CFE/3B0B

fields.name: f1_var_1c
fields.meaning: Unknown; 1 from early in a new game
fields.evidence: stored by 5000:0021 at game start; read at B000:C25A

fields.name: f1_turn
fields.meaning: Battle turn number; shown on the battle screen as TURN nn
fields.evidence: set to 1 at battle start (6000:218D), incremented each round (6000:3272); 1->2->3 across play states; battle screenshot shows TURN 01 with value 1

fields.name: f1_battle_phase
fields.meaning: Side to move: 0 = enemy phase (moves first each turn), 1 = player phase
fields.evidence: 0 at battle start (6000:2193), set to 1 at 6000:32AB/c000:43C8, turn ticks on entering 0 (6000:3272); screenshot shows PLAYER PHASE with value 1; 0 side inferred

fields.name: f1_units_active
fields.meaning: Own units still in action, recounted over the 49 unit records
fields.evidence: code c000:BA92 counts (flag bits 0/2 and byte+0x18 bit 3)

fields.name: f1_units_start
fields.meaning: Own units at battle start
fields.evidence: code c000:C2A9 counts at battle setup

fields.name: f1_units_pct
fields.meaning: Remaining force in percent: 100 * active / start
fields.evidence: code c000:BAC4 computes (calls BA92 first); value matches in all saves

fields.name: f1_var_23
fields.meaning: Unknown 16-bit counter (set to 0x600 in one routine, incremented in another, snapshotted at stage transitions)

fields.name: f1_var_25
fields.meaning: Unknown; 0x20 from game start
fields.evidence: stored by 5000:00FF at game start; read c000:0D39/0D5E/0DB5/9930, 6000:1FF0

fields.name: f1_var_26
fields.meaning: Unknown; 0x20 from game start
fields.evidence: stored by 5000:010B at game start; read c000:0D8B/0DBF/0E3E, 6000:2018

fields.name: f1_day_index_a
fields.meaning: Day-counter part A: per-stage base from ROM table c000:B96B[stage] (stage 2 = 6)
fields.evidence: written by c000:B947 inside day recompute c000:B917; 0 in observed saves

fields.name: f1_day_index_b
fields.meaning: Day-counter part B: sum of per-flag day costs (ROM table c000:B94F) over set stage flags
fields.evidence: written by c000:B936 inside day recompute c000:B917; 0 in observed saves

fields.name: f1_days_left
fields.meaning: Days left until Earth is destroyed (shown as "after 369 days" on the Load screen)
fields.evidence: Load screen 4000:856C reads; set from ROM calendar table by c000:B9C1; value 369

fields.name: f1_year
fields.meaning: Calendar year (2199)
fields.evidence: code c000:B9C8 from calendar table; value 0x0897

fields.name: f1_month
fields.meaning: Calendar month (10)
fields.evidence: code c000:B9CF from calendar table

fields.name: f1_day
fields.meaning: Calendar day of month (3)
fields.evidence: code c000:B9D6 from calendar table

fields.name: f1_var_31
fields.meaning: Unknown mode/state word (takes values 0x12/0x25/0x4B in battle code incl. after suspending; 0 when saved)

fields.name: f1_var_33
fields.meaning: Unknown small counter (0xFF at new game; set to 2/3/4 and incremented in stage code)
fields.evidence: new-game init (=0xFF); writers INC c000:3D33/3D69, MOV c000:3BF6-44C9

fields.name: f1_unknown_34
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero in every observed save (upper part is scratch cleared at stage transitions)
fields.evidence: diffs; stage reset c000:CA4A clears 0x80 bytes at 0x140C

fields.name: f1_stage_flags
fields.meaning: Per-stage flags: slot ROM-table c000:B8F0[stage] is set to 1; entry 1 is set from game start
fields.evidence: code c000:4177 writes [0x148C+table[stage]]=1; new-game init sets entry 1; table has 28 entries

fields.name: f1_cleared_flag
fields.meaning: Game-cleared flag: when set, the title and load menus offer extra entries and the 16 unlock flags are all set to 1
fields.evidence: set by c000:C9F4 and battle-result transfer 6000:E3DB; read d000:0822/06C2, 4000:82EB/8783

fields.name: f1_unlock_flags
fields.meaning: 16 unlock flags (entries 0, 1, 8 set at new game; all set once the game is cleared)
fields.evidence: new-game init sets 3; d000:0822 sets all 16 then rewrites check word and backup

fields.name: f1_scratch_f6
fields.meaning: Scratch snapshot area written at stage transitions (copies of the 0x23 counter, crew, a block-B slice, days left); zero in observed saves
fields.evidence: written by c000:C9F9 block; diffs

fields.name: f1_settings_copy
fields.meaning: Copy of live bytes 0x13DD/0x13DE (both 1 from boot) taken at save time and restored on load; 0 in the second byte triggers extra init 4000:662D on load
fields.evidence: save c000:CB42 / load c000:CCC9; boot sets both to 1 at 4000:4245/424A

fields.name: f1_var_111
fields.meaning: Unknown; 0xFF from early in stage 1
fields.evidence: set to 0xFF by c000:BB4E; read c000:17D5/5AAA/5B6C/C62D; diff across play states

fields.name: f1_materials
fields.meaning: MATERIALS resource (shown on the Load screen; capped at 9999)
fields.evidence: Load screen 4000:8546 reads; c000:433B adds the pending gain and clamps to 9999; battle transfer 6000:E399

fields.name: f1_crew
fields.meaning: CREW count (always 114 minus LOST; 114 at new game)
fields.evidence: Load screen 4000:84EF; computed as 0x72 - lost by c000:4364/4382 and 6000:127A

fields.name: f1_lost
fields.meaning: LOST count (sum of the two loss counters at 0x116/0x117)
fields.evidence: Load screen 4000:851C; summed by c000:435A/4378 and 6000:126A

fields.name: f1_lost_a
fields.meaning: Loss counter A (raised/lowered by the crew-loss routines; added into LOST)
fields.evidence: INC/DEC c000:4356/4374, zeroed c000:CA72

fields.name: f1_lost_b
fields.meaning: Loss counter B (raised in battle accounting; added into LOST)

fields.name: f1_unknown_118
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero (first byte is zeroed together with the loss counters)
fields.evidence: diffs; c000:CA7C and 6000:123B/1265/127F touch 0x118

fields.name: f1_var_130
fields.meaning: Unknown 7-byte battle-results block (06 01 00 08 08 08 08 at new game; first byte is a counter)
fields.evidence: new-game init 6000:1DC0; battle-result copy 6000:E3A1; INC c000:439A, =6 c000:5B15

fields.name: f1_unknown_137
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero in every observed save
fields.evidence: diffs

fields.name: f1_ship_slots
fields.meaning: 22-entry table: battle unit number assigned to each ship, 0xFF = none
fields.evidence: c000:BEDF fills 0xFF, c000:C325 assigns, new-game init fills 0xFF; diffs

fields.name: f1_materials_gain
fields.meaning: Pending MATERIALS gain: added into MATERIALS (capped at 9999) by c000:433B, then cleared
fields.evidence: accumulated by ADD 6000:3048; consumed c000:4341; cleared c000:4333

fields.name: file2
fields.meaning: File 2: same layout as File 1 (0x0010-0x01B4) shifted by 0x1A5; check word at 0x01B5, "YAMATO" at 0x01B7
fields.evidence: code c000:CBCF-CC2A; second-file save holds identical data with matching check

fields.name: file1_backup
fields.meaning: Backup copy of File 1, written right after it; used to restore File 1 at power-on if File 1 fails its check (both erased if both fail)
fields.evidence: code c000:CBB1 copy, c000:CD4F restore; verified save

fields.name: file2_backup
fields.meaning: Backup copy of File 2 (same rule)
fields.evidence: code c000:CC2D, c000:CD4F; second-file save

fields.name: suspend_check
fields.meaning: Suspend record check word: XOR8 | SUM8<<8 over the 0xCEE bytes from 0x06A6
fields.evidence: code c000:CF1F writes, c000:CE5A checks; recomputed on the suspend save (match)

fields.name: suspend_magic
fields.meaning: Signature "YAMATO" of the suspend record; when valid the title offers resume
fields.evidence: code c000:CEAD writes, c000:CE5A checks; title menu d000:06C2 reads

fields.name: suspend_main
fields.meaning: Same main game block as File 1 0x0018-0x0110
fields.evidence: code c000:CEE2 (copy of live 0x13DF)

fields.name: suspend_fleet
fields.meaning: Same fleet block as File 1 0x0111-0x01B4
fields.evidence: code c000:CEFE (copy of live 0x14D8)

fields.name: suspend_battle
fields.meaning: Battle/map state at the moment of suspending (unit records etc.); internal layout not decoded
fields.evidence: code c000:CF1A (copy of live 0x1697); suspend save resumes into the battle

fields.name: work_memory
fields.meaning: Not save data: the game uses the rest of the cartridge RAM as working memory (the live save blocks sit at 0x13DF/0x14D8/0x1697)
fields.evidence: boot read trace reads only 0x0010-0x1393; code uses 1000:13xx-5xxx as variables

fields.name: ieep_unused
fields.meaning: Not used by this game: byte-identical in every observed state including power-on
fields.evidence: diffs of all internal-EEPROM images vs power-on

values.value: byte-identical in every save checked, including power-on; this game keeps all saves in cartridge SRAM
